name: Priceline VIP Rewards Visa® Card

apr.notes: Variable APR 19.49%–29.99% for purchases (based on creditworthiness); cash advance APR 29.99%. 0% introductory APR for 15 billing cycles on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. Balance transfer fee: 5% (min. $5). Cash advance fee: 5% (min. $10). Minimum monthly interest charge $0.50.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee: 0%. No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

base_rate.description: Earn 1X points on all other purchases.

categories.label: 10X points on Avis and Budget car rentals booked through Priceline
2X points on gas and restaurant purchases, including delivery services

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points for statement credits, gift cards, and more. For example, redeem 5,000 points for a $50 statement credit. No limit on the number of points you can earn.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 20,000 Bonus points after spending $500 within the first 90 days after account opening — enough to redeem for a $200 statement credit.

benefits.title: Low Intro APR on Balance Transfers
benefits.description: 0% Intro APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. After that, a variable APR will apply, 19.49% to 29.99%.

benefits.title: Up to $120 Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Application Fee Statement Credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee statement credit each anniversary year if you spend $10,000 on purchases.

benefits.title: $50 Cruise Statement Credit
benefits.description: Earn a $50 cruise statement credit when you make a Priceline cruise booking.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: Free Online FICO Credit Score Access
benefits.description: Free online access to your FICO Score lets you keep an eye on your credit score and get email alerts when we learn that your score has changed.

benefits.title: Priceline VIP Gold Status
benefits.description: Automatic Priceline VIP Gold Status and exclusive deals, including coupons up to 20% off.

notes: No annual fee. Visa Signature card (applicants not meeting credit criteria may receive a Platinum card with different benefits). Rewards: 5x on Priceline bookings, 10x on Avis/Budget car rentals via Priceline, 2x on gas/restaurants, 1x elsewhere. All rates/fees/benefits verified from official Priceline Visa product page.
